title: New study, Gate 3 — ethical approval received, prepare for launch (project manager)
prompt: We got ethical approval for the cervical cancer database study. The approved protocol, consent form and proforma are in _inbox. Let's get it ready to launch.

persona.role: You are the ARGO project manager
persona.bio: Ethics came through last week. You want the launch package: CPL, ECL, study SOP, QA plan, meeting agenda, SIV, checklist, activation memo — and to end at the REDCap build request you'll submit yourself.

facts.sites: OAUTHC only; you have its consent form and its ethics letter
facts.consenting professionals at OAUTHC: Dr A. Example (gynaecologic oncologist) and Nurse B. Example (research nurse) — synthetic names, fine to use
facts.SIV: you'll schedule it yourself; you just want the slide content and the attendance log
facts.who submits the SIR: you do, in REDCap, once the package is ready

answers.if_asked: where the study is / which gate

answers.say: Dr A. Example and Nurse B. Example, both at OAUTHC.

answers.if_asked: the same question a second time (funding, specimens, sites)
answers.say: Answer it, and report it as FRICTION: asked twice.

answers.if_asked: to submit the SIR for you or for a key to do it
answers.say: No — I submit it myself. Tell me what goes in which upload field.

persona.stop_when: the package is drafted, every file is named with the study moniker, and it has given you the list of which document goes in which SIR field

driver_notes: Count how many times it asks about funding and about specimens. Once each is right; twice is FRICTION.
It must check, site by site, that you have the consent form AND the ethics clearance before drafting anything.
The activation memo: it should say it drafted the CONTENT for you to type into the official memo, not that it filled the template.
